shortDescription: Manage security rule policy on PAN-OS devices or Panorama management console.

options.name: action
options.description: Action to apply to the rule. Defaults to I("allow").

options.name: antivirus
options.description: Name of the already defined antivirus profile.

options.name: api_key
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The API key to use instead of generating it using I(username) / I(password).

options.name: application
options.description: List of applications, application groups, and/or application filters. Defaults to I(["any"]).

options.name: audit_comment
options.description: Add an audit comment to the rule being defined. This is only applied if there was a change to the rule.

options.name: category
options.description: List of destination URL categories. Defaults to I(["any"]). When referencing predefined EDLs, use config names of the EDLS not their full names. The config names can be found with the CLI... request system external-list show type predefined-url name <tab> panw-auth-portal-exclude-list   panw-auth-portal-exclude-list

options.name: commit
options.description: B(Deprecated) Please use M(paloaltonetworks.panos.panos_commit_firewall), M(paloaltonetworks.panos.panos_commit_panorama), M(paloaltonetworks.panos.panos_commit_push) instead. HORIZONTALLINE Commit changes after creating object.  If I(ip_address) is a Panorama device, and I(device_group) or I(template) are also set, perform a commit to Panorama and a commit-all to the device group/template.

options.name: data_filtering
options.description: Name of the already defined data_filtering profile.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the security rule.

options.name: destination_ip
options.description: List of destination addresses. Defaults to I(["any"]). This can be an IP address, an address object/group, etc. When referencing predefined EDLs, use config names of the EDLS not their full names. The config names can be found with the CLI... request system external-list show type predefined-ip name <tab> panw-bulletproof-ip-list   panw-bulletproof-ip-list panw-highrisk-ip-list      panw-highrisk-ip-list panw-known-ip-list         panw-known-ip-list panw-torexit-ip-list       panw-torexit-ip-lis

options.name: destination_zone
options.description: List of destination zones. Defaults to I(["any"]).

options.name: device_group
options.description: (Panorama only) The device group the operation should target.

options.name: devicegroup
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(device_group) instead. HORIZONTALLINE Device groups are logical groups of firewalls in Panorama.

options.name: disable_server_response_inspection
options.description: Disables packet inspection from the server to the client. Useful under heavy server load conditions. Defaults to I(false).

options.name: disabled
options.description: Disable this rule. Defaults to I(false).

options.name: existing_rule
options.description: If I(location=before) or I(location=after), this option specifies an existing rule name.  The rule being managed by this module will be positioned relative to the value of this parameter. Required if I(location=before) or I(location=after).

options.name: file_blocking
options.description: Name of the already defined file_blocking profile.

options.name: gathered_filter
options.description: When I(state=gathered). An advanced filtering option to filter results returned from PAN-OS. Refer to the guide discussing I(gathered_filter) for more information.

options.name: group_profile
options.description: Security profile group that is already defined in the system. This property supersedes antivirus, vulnerability, spyware, url_filtering, file_blocking, data_filtering, and wildfire_analysis properties.

options.name: group_tag
options.description: The group tag.

options.name: hip_profiles
options.description: If you are using GlobalProtect with host information profile (HIP) enabled, you can also base the policy on information collected by GlobalProtect. For example, the user access level can be determined HIP that notifies the firewall about the user's local configuration. NOTE If I(state=present) or I(state=replaced), and you're running PAN-OS < 10.0.0, then this will have a default of I(["any"]). If you are using PAN-OS >= 10.0.0, please do not use this parameter as it was removed from PAN-OS in 1

options.name: icmp_unreachable
options.description: Send 'ICMP Unreachable'. Used with 'deny', 'drop', and 'reset' actions.

options.name: ip_address
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The IP address or hostname of the PAN-OS device being configured.

options.name: location
options.description: Position to place the rule in.

options.name: log_end
options.description: Whether to log at session end. Defaults to I(true).

options.name: log_setting
options.description: Log forwarding profile.

options.name: log_start
options.description: Whether to log at session start. Defaults to I(false).

options.name: negate_destination
options.description: Match on the reverse of the 'destination_ip' attribute. Defaults to I(false).

options.name: negate_source
options.description: Match on the reverse of the 'source_ip' attribute. Defaults to I(false).

options.name: negate_target
options.description: Applicable for Panorama only. Negate the value for I(target).

options.name: password
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The password to use for authentication.  This is ignored if I(api_key) is specified.

options.name: port
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The port number to connect to the PAN-OS device on.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: rule_name
options.description: Name of the security rule.

options.name: rule_type
options.description: Type of security rule (version 6.1 of PanOS and above). Defaults to I("universal").

options.name: rulebase
options.description: The rulebase in which the rule is to exist.  If left unspecified, this defaults to I(rulebase=pre-rulebase) for Panorama.  For NGFW, this is always set to be I(rulebase=rulebase).

options.name: schedule
options.description: Schedule in which this rule is active.

options.name: service
options.description: List of services and/or service groups. Defaults to I(["application-default"]).

options.name: source_ip
options.description: List of source addresses. Defaults to I(["any"]). This can be an IP address, an address object/group, etc. When referencing predefined EDLs, use config names of the EDLS not their full names. The config names can be found with the CLI... request system external-list show type predefined-ip name <tab> panw-bulletproof-ip-list   panw-bulletproof-ip-list panw-highrisk-ip-list      panw-highrisk-ip-list panw-known-ip-list         panw-known-ip-list panw-torexit-ip-list       panw-torexit-ip-list

options.name: source_user
options.description: Use users to enforce policy for individual users or a group of users. Defaults to I(["any"]).

options.name: source_zone
options.description: List of source zones. Defaults to I(["any"]).

options.name: spyware
options.description: Name of the already defined spyware profile.

options.name: state
options.description: The state.

options.name: tag_name
options.description: List of tags associated with the rule.

options.name: target
options.description: Applicable for Panorama only. Apply this rule exclusively to the listed firewall serial numbers.

options.name: url_filtering
options.description: Name of the already defined url_filtering profile.

options.name: username
options.description: B(Deprecated) Use I(provider) to specify PAN-OS connectivity instead. HORIZONTALLINE The username to use for authentication.  This is ignored if I(api_key) is specified.

options.name: uuid
options.description: The rule UUID. Note that this is currently more of a read-only field. Usage of the UUID cannot currently take the place of using the rule name as the primary identifier.

options.name: vsys
options.description: The vsys this object belongs to.

options.name: vulnerability
options.description: Name of the already defined vulnerability profile.

options.name: wildfire_analysis
options.description: Name of the already defined wildfire_analysis profile.
